name: order-number-sequences
database: PostgreSQL16 exact named disposable clone; normal fixtures rollback; race commits synthetic rows only
baseline: The pre-migration real POS RED captures only old-number count/digest to ORDER_NUMBER_QA_BASELINE_FILE, default /tmp/order-number-qa-before161.json

cases.N161-01: Actual paid POS completion returns the persisted POS-0000001
cases.N161-02: Existing numbers match the pre-migration digest
cases.N161-03: Unconverted drafts allocate nothing; manual conversion shares POS
cases.N161-04: Real RPC retry and recovery preserve numbers without increments
cases.N161-05: Independent per-store WEB/POS helper allocation, retry and late imported-number collision
cases.N161-06: Permanent deletion retains ledger, prevents reuse and deleted-order recreation
cases.N161-07: Failed orders INSERT rolls back the allocator and counter together
cases.N161-08: Private grants, allocated identity and rollback metadata immutability
cases.N161-09: Minimum width expands; bigint exhaustion is explicit
cases.N161-10: Two-connection distinct-order and same-order allocation races
cases.N161-11: Exact down migration refuses durable allocations and preserves function and numbering-table hashes

raceCleanup: The coordinator drops the isolated clone after rehearsing committed synthetic race fixtures

integrations.cases: Six real WEB creators, builtin retry/protected receipt, and zero/two tracked stock settlement/replay; all integration fixtures rollback
